meta.parties: Pietetsz v. Bastian Fernando Et Al

rules.statement: A lease for a term of years can be considered an alienation under the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance, and if granted by an incumbent with proper authority, it is valid.
rules.supporting_quote: "Reading sections 27 and 42 together, I think it a reasonable inference that it was intended to include a lease within the term 'alienation' as used in that section."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 42 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance.
